description: This file defines the Duration class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically for handling and formatting duration-based number formats in spreadsheets. It includes constants for various duration units, format blocks, and separators, as well as methods for constructing and managing duration format strings.

classes.name: Duration
classes.description: Class for creating and managing duration format strings in spreadsheet styling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Duration object with optional separators and format blocks, setting up default duration formats if none are specified.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Returns the formatted duration string based on the configured format blocks and separators.

methods.name: mapFormatBlocks
methods.description: Maps input format block strings to internal representation, ensuring duration masks are correctly set and literals are wrapped in quotes.
